steps._comment: == THE REPORT, on the recovery arm. ==

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: This is the only shop on the street where a woman may sit for an hour and be assumed to be choosing ink.

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: You went, then. Sit down and tell me what he said, and please tell me the whole of it. I have had forty years of the polite half.

steps._comment: Two visible rows: the recovery report arm, then 'Another time.'

payload_contains.speaker: A Lady with a Ring Box
payload_contains.text: Then it is done, and done in the open, which I did not expect and did not know I wanted. Here. My mother had a second piece, plain, honest, worth a tenth of the first and worn twice as often. I would rather it went to somebody who earned it than sat in a box being important.
